description: This file is a core PHP source file that provides a wide array of utility functions and includes for the TestLink open source test management application. It handles database connection, session management, user rights, page initialization, redirection, configuration, and other fundamental operations for the project.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Represents a user within the TestLink system with methods to read user data, check rights, and retrieve display names.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Represents a test project entity, with methods to retrieve accessible projects and options.

classes.name: tlObjectWithDB
classes.description: Provides static methods related to objects that interact with the database, including retrieving table names.

methods.name: doDBConnect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database and handles error reporting.

methods.name: setSessionTestPlan
methods.description: Sets session variables related to the current test plan.

methods.name: setPaths
methods.description: Sets the base URL path for the application if not already set.

methods.name: checkSessionValid
methods.description: Verifies if the user session is still valid, redirects to login if not.

methods.name: doSessionStart
methods.description: Starts PHP session with specific parameters and optionally sets URL paths.

methods.name: initTopMenu
methods.description: Initializes the top menu based on user rights and project/test plan state.

methods.name: initProject
methods.description: Initializes project and test plan data in the session, adjusts UI accordingly.

methods.name: testlinkInitPage
methods.description: Performs core page initialization including session, database, rights, and project setup.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects the browser to a specified URL via JavaScript.

methods.name: strings_stripSlashes
methods.description: Sanitizes input strings or arrays by stripping slashes, considering magic quotes.

methods.name: to_boolean
methods.description: Converts various representations to boolean value (0 or 1).

methods.name: check_string
methods.description: Validates a string against a forbidden pattern with a regex.

methods.name: config_get
methods.description: Retrieves configuration parameters or defaults.

methods.name: is_blank
methods.description: Checks if a string is empty or contains only whitespace.

methods.name: downloadContentsToFile
methods.description: Prepares and outputs HTTP headers to trigger file download with given content.

methods.name: microtime_float
methods.description: Returns current time as float for performance timing.

methods.name: priority_to_level
methods.description: Converts a numeric priority to a level string (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW).

methods.name: ini_get_bool
methods.description: Retrieves ini setting and returns it as boolean.

methods.name: trim_and_limit
methods.description: Trims a string and limits its length to a specified maximum.

methods.name: transform_nodes_order
methods.description: Transforms a string representation of nodes order into an array of node IDs.

methods.name: getFileUploadErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns human-readable message based on $_FILES upload error code.

methods.name: show_instructions
methods.description: Redirects to a static instruction page from locale files.

methods.name: templateConfiguration
methods.description: Builds template configuration object based on current script filename.

methods.name: isValidISODateTime
methods.description: Validates if a string matches ISO date/time format.

methods.name: is_valid_date
methods.description: Checks if a timestamp matches the localized date format.

methods.name: split_localized_date
methods.description: Splits a localized date string into its components.

methods.name: checkUserRightsFor
methods.description: Checks if the current user has specific rights, redirects or exits if not.

methods.name: getItemTemplateContents
methods.description: Loads template content for an item based on configuration and type.

methods.name: buildExternalIdString
methods.description: Builds an external ID string with prefix and external ID.

methods.name: displayMemUsage
methods.description: Outputs current memory usage and timestamp for debugging.

methods.name: setUpEnvForRemoteAccess
methods.description: Initializes environment variables for remote API access, authenticates user.

methods.name: getLabels
methods.description: Generates label mappings from configuration keys for UI display.

methods.name: setDateTimeFormats
methods.description: Sets date/time formats based on locale.

methods.name: windowCloseAndOpenerReload
methods.description: Closes window and reloads opener via JavaScript.

methods.name: setUpEnvForAnonymousAccess
methods.description: Initializes environment for anonymous API access, with optional rights check.

methods.name: getEntityByAPIKey
methods.description: Retrieves entity ID by API key for testproject or testplan.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Checks if user has rights in a given context, throws exception if not.

methods.name: getWebEditorCfg
methods.description: Retrieves web editor configuration settings.

methods.name: downloadXls
methods.description: Prepares and triggers download of an Excel XLS/XLSX file.

methods.name: syslogOnCloud
methods.description: Sends syslog messages to Papertrail cloud logging service.

methods.name: getSSODisable
methods.description: Checks whether SSO is disabled based on request parameters.

methods.name: tlSetCookie
methods.description: Sets a cookie based on configuration and provided object.

methods.name: initUserEnv
methods.description: Initializes user environment, including login, rights, and project context.

methods.name: getGrantSetWithExit
methods.description: Determines user grants and rights, redirecting on certain conditions.

methods.name: getAccess
methods.description: Derives access rights for the UI based on grants.

methods.name: getMenuVisibility
methods.description: Creates menu visibility structure based on permissions and project state.

methods.name: setSystemWideActiveMenuOFF
methods.description: Resets active menu items to off.

methods.name: getFirstLevelMenuStructure
methods.description: Provides initial structure for main menu.

methods.name: doTestPlanSetup
methods.description: Selects a test plan from the available list, applying default rules.

methods.name: initContext
methods.description: Initializes operational context from request parameters.

methods.name: pageAccessCheck
methods.description: Verifies user access rights in current context.

methods.name: XSS_StringScriptSafe
methods.description: Checks if content contains potentially dangerous <script> tags.
